title: CampaignInput
description: Left out, audience and company come from your company context (the audience your website read found; with no website read yet, send audience), geography is worldwide and desired_outcome is the goal's usual outcome; the answer's defaults names each field filled. A 422 names every required field that is missing, each in details.problems.

budget_usd.description: The most to spend, in US dollars. The plan is held to this key's mandate: never above its maximum plan total or what is left of its monthly cap.

budget_min_usd.description: The least to spend. Above the mandate's maximum plan total, or what is left of its monthly cap, the campaign is refused (mandate_refused). Left out, the budget is held to the mandate instead of refused.
